name: bo1z-controller-mapper
description: Chrome extension that makes any controller work on vel.gg/bo1z by remapping it to the standard (Xbox) gamepad layout

scripts.package: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/bo1z-controller-mapper && cp -r extension/. dist/bo1z-controller-mapper/ && cd dist && zip -qr ../bo1z-controller-mapper.zip bo1z-controller-mapper
